entities.summary: The Cathedral Basilica of the Holy Saviour Also San Salvador de Jujuy Cathedral Is the seat of the Catholic bishopric of the city of San Salvador de Jujuy in Argentina, as well as a historic building of the country. The work was declared National Historical Monument by Decree No. 1347 of May 16, 1931.
